verdict.rationale: Pandoc is documented as a standalone command-line program and Haskell library that users install locally via Homebrew or Chocolatey. It can be compiled as a fully self-contained binary, so conversion clearly runs on the user's own machine. Network access is opt-in, used only when the user supplies a URL as input; the online demos and server mode are optional. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement that files are never uploaded, any documented offline or no-telemetry guarantee, and independent or hands-on corroboration of offline operation.
